Travel to the north field, initiate the weed detection sequence, and send a report back to the central server before returning to the base.

Proceed to section D of the assembly line, monitor the conveyor belt speed for inconsistencies, make necessary adjustments, and log all changes in the system before heading back to the monitoring station.

Navigate to the southern field corner and conduct a perimeter scan to detect unauthorized entries or anomalies; any potential issues should trigger an alert to the control center before proceeding to the eastern irrigation control to perform routine checks.

Travel along the automated conveyor line to the loading dock, pause at checkpoint B for a security scan, and upon clearance, load the conveyor with new consignment boxes to be transported to the sorting area for package distribution.
Navigate to the strawberry field and wait by the edge for the harvesting team to arrive. Once they load two crates of strawberries, drive directly to the cooling shed for unloading.

Proceed to the East storage unit to collect three pallets of fertilizer. After loading is complete, transport them to the irrigation control center and wait until they are fully unloaded before returning to the docking station for recharging.

Move to the fruit orchard and gather three baskets of ripe apples. Once collected, drive to the sorting facility and wait until all baskets are unloaded. Afterwards, proceed to the refueling station to recharge for 10 minutes before returning to the orchard.

Navigate to the chemical storage area to pick up two canisters of pesticide. Transport these to the spraying zone in the west field. After delivery, wait for 15 minutes for the spray operation to be completed, then transport the empty canisters back to the chemical storage.

Travel to the packaging unit to collect five bundles of cardboard boxes. Deliver these to the loading dock and ensure they are unloaded. Once this task is complete, return to the packaging unit and wait for further instructions.

Head towards the tool shed and collect a set of specialized gardening tools. Deliver them to the greenhouse entrance, then proceed to the perimeter path and patrol the area for 20 minutes. Once complete, return to the tool shed.

Drive to the dairy barn to pick up a container of fresh milk. Deliver it to the processing plant. After unloading, move to the pasture gate and wait there for 30 minutes to assist with cattle management activities. Then, head back to the dairy barn.

Navigate to the vineyard and pick up 5 baskets of freshly harvested grapes. Then, proceed to the fermentation building and unload the baskets at the intake area. After unloading, return to the vineyard and stand by for further instructions.

Proceed to the fertilization zone, pick up two canisters of organic fertilizer, and transport them to Field 7-A. Once in the field, wait for the supervisors to confirm the location before dispensing the fertilizer.

Travel to the loading bay and collect a pallet of spare engine parts. Deliver the pallet to the engineering lab located in the west wing of the facility. After delivery, wait for 30 minutes in the lab for any additional transport requests.

Go to the solar panel farm and perform a surface inspection of the panels in Section C. After the inspection, return to the operations center and report findings to the maintenance team. No waiting is required between tasks.

Head to the orchard and collect three crates of apples. Drive to the packaging station in the north sector, unload the crates onto the conveyor belt, and then proceed to the rest zone to recharge for 25 minutes.
Head to the sunflower field to collect 5 jars of sunflower seeds, then transport them to the packaging shed and wait for them to be unloaded.
Navigate to the machinery storage room, pick up the spare hydraulic pump, and deliver it directly to the tractor maintenance area.
Drive to the loading bay, retrieve a pallet of seed bags, and take them to the greenhouse entrance. After delivery, return to the initial position at the loading bay.
Proceed to the orchard's water tank, fill two containers with fresh water, and deliver them to the vegetable patch. Once delivered, wait for 10 minutes for a refill order.
Travel to the chemical shed, pick up two canisters of pest control liquid, and drop them off at the vineyard. Then head back and wait at the chemical shed for restocking instructions.
Head to the vineyard and pick up 20 baskets of grapes. Transport them to the fermentation room and wait there until all baskets are unloaded.
Proceed to the solar panel field maintenance area and pick up a toolbox. Next, deliver the toolbox to the hillside observatory.
Navigate to the loading bay and collect two pallets of wheat. Deliver these to the silo storage facility, then immediately return to the loading bay for further instructions.

Drive to the chemical storage unit to collect 5 barrels of fertilizer. Transport these barrels to the irrigation control center and wait for 10 minutes after delivery before returning to the chemical storage unit.
Make your way to the livestock barn and collect three bags of feed. Distribute them evenly at the designated feeding stations, then return to the barn for any additional tasks.
Head to the north orchard and pick up two baskets of ripe apples. Once collected, deliver them to the fruit processing facility located near the eastern entrance.
Drive to the construction site storage area and collect four bags of cement. Transport these to the building zone C and wait there until the site manager confirms the delivery.
Proceed to the tool shed to pick up a box of wrenches. Take the wrenches to the wind turbine assembly station near the south field, and remain there for 10 minutes for potential further instructions.
Travel to the solar panel storage room located in the eco-park. Collect one batch of panels and deliver them carefully to the installation area on the west side.

Move to the loading dock at the rear of the factory to collect a container of industrial oils. Deliver the container to the vehicle maintenance unit, then return to the loading dock for a new task allocation.

Travel to the solar field and collect five solar panel units. Deliver them to the installation site, ensuring they're safely unloaded. Wait there for 15 minutes for any additional parts, then head back to the solar field and wait for further instructions.

Head to the west orchard and gather a load of ripe berries. Proceed to the distribution center and unload the berries into bin 3. Then, transition to the farm's logistics office and await further tasks for the next 10 minutes.

Navigate to the fertilizer storage to pick up two barrels of organic compost. Deliver these barrels to the south crop field for spreading. After unloading, move to the nearby workshop for a system check and wait for 30 minutes before returning to start.

Drive to the receiving area to pick up a shipment of PVC pipes. Take them to the irrigation setup site for unloading. Post-delivery, move to the control station and monitor water flow systems for the next 20 minutes before proceeding to the maintenance garage.

Visit the machinery shed to obtain the oil drum. Transport it to the mechanical repair bay and ensure it is positioned beside the hydraulic press. Then proceed to the control room where you will wait for 15 minutes before heading back to the shed to report the completion of tasks.
Head to the north field and collect three baskets of harvested corn. Transport them to the storage silo, then wait until all baskets have been unloaded.
Travel to the greenhouse, locate the tool cart, and load it onto the robot. Deliver the tool cart to the vineyard maintenance area, and once delivered, return to the greenhouse.
Proceed to the livestock barn and pick up a bale of hay. Transfer it to the feeding trough area, and after unloading, wait for 10 minutes to ensure no additional assistance is needed.

Move to the loading dock and pick up two crates of fresh produce. Deliver the crates to the produce washing station. Once the crates are unloaded, stand by for an additional 5 minutes for any further tasks.

Navigate to Zone C in the orchard and collect the pruning equipment. Deliver the equipment to Zone A and wait there until the pruning team has all their tools, then return to the initial starting point.

Navigate to the orchard and collect the bins of harvested lemons. Deliver them to the processing unit, wait for them to be unloaded, then proceed to the packaging section and remain there for 15 minutes before heading back to the orchard.

Travel to the supply depot to pick up three rolls of fabric. Deliver them to the textile workshop. Once there, await unloading, then go to the administrative office for any additional tasks, remaining for a 10-minute standby before heading to the start point.

Proceed to the greenhouse to collect 5 potted plants and deliver them to the botanical lab. Once completed, reposition to the logistics center and await the loading of fertilizer bags. Take the fertilizer to the mixing area, ensure it's unloaded, and then perform a thorough inspection for the next 20 minutes.

Head to the vehicle repair zone to pick up two spare tires. Move them to the tractor bay, ensure their delivery, then proceed to the fueling station to refuel and wait for 10 minutes before returning to the vehicle repair zone for cycle continuation.

Go to the aqua farm docks to pick up a batch of fish feed. Deliver this to the feeding station in the aquaculture facility. After unloading, transition to the observation deck for environmental monitoring, staying idle for 30 minutes before navigating back to the aqua farm docks.

Go to the orchard and pick up five crates of harvested apples. Proceed to the packaging unit and wait until the crates are unloaded. Once unloaded, travel to the recharge station to charge for 10 minutes before the next task.

Head towards the logistics center and collect a pallet of auto parts. Deliver the pallet to the shipping dock. After completing the delivery, wait for any return shipments for 10 minutes. If none arrive, return to the central depot.

Navigate to the fertilizer storage area to collect three bags of fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer bags to the greenhouse facility and wait until they are unloaded. Once completed, proceed to the equipment bay for regular maintenance checks.

Proceed to the orchard and collect a dozen crates of harvested tomatoes. Transport these crates to the packaging facility and wait until all the crates are unloaded. After completion, travel to the nearby shade area and rest for 10 minutes before heading back to the orchard.

Navigate to the chemical storage unit to pick up five sealed bottles of fertilizer. Carefully transport them to the greenhouse section and ensure they are unloaded with caution. Then, make your way to the adjacent control station and remain there for 20 minutes for monitoring purposes before returning to the chemical storage.

Drive to the fuel depot to retrieve a small canister of diesel. Deliver it to the vehicle maintenance bay, ensuring it is stored properly. Once done, proceed to the lunch area and wait there for 15 minutes, then head back to the maintenance bay for further instructions.

Make your way to the barn to collect a stack of hay bales. Transport these bales to the animal feeding area. After unloading, go to the water supply unit and wait for 5 minutes to ensure the hydration systems are functioning well. Return to the barn to complete the task.

Go to the shipping zone and load two boxes of electronic components. Deliver them to the computer manufacturing line. After ensuring they are fully unloaded, proceed to the logistics office and stand by for 30 minutes to assist with inventory management, before heading back to the shipping zone.
Drive to the lumber yard and collect two bundles of timber. Deliver them to the sawmill’s front entrance, then wait for the bundles to be unloaded.
Travel to the fertilizer storage shed, pick up three fertilizer bags, and bring them to field plot B. After delivery, return to the maintenance garage.
Move to the vineyard loading area, pick up a crate of freshly harvested grapes, and carry it to the wine-processing facility. Wait until the crate is removed by staff.
Proceed to the equipment shed and collect a toolbox. Take the toolbox to irrigation pump station 2 and wait for 10 minutes before returning to the shed.
Go to the orchard’s west entrance, pick up apple crates, and deliver them to cold storage. Wait for 5 minutes at cold storage.
Head to the chemical storehouse, load a sealed barrel onto the robot, and transport it to the mixing platform near the east greenhouse. Stand by until the barrel is removed.
Travel to the solar panel array, wait for 20 minutes while the panel maintenance team finishes repairs, then return to the operations center.
Proceed to the livestock barn, pick up a feed bin, and bring it to paddock 4. After delivery, immediately return to the barn.
Go to the spare parts warehouse, collect two replacement wheels, and deliver them to the tractor bay.
Move to the rainwater collection tank, pick up an empty cistern, and carry it to the irrigation control hut. Wait there for the cistern to be filled, then return it to the original pickup point.

Drive to the fertilizer storage shed and pick up two bags of fertilizer. Deliver these to field section B. Wait for 12 minutes while the bags are unloaded, then proceed to the irrigation pump station for further instructions.

Travel to the solar panel array to collect a toolbox. Transport the toolbox to the windmill site and wait there until the maintenance crew removes it from the robot. Once unloaded, continue to the administration office and wait for 5 minutes before returning to the garage.

Head over to the barn and collect a crate of fresh eggs. Take the crate to the farmers’ market stall for drop off. After delivery, continue to the repair bay and remain there until the supervisor retrieves the empty crate, then go back to the barn.

Navigate to the spare parts depot to pick up a box of replacement filters. Deliver the box to Station 3 of the processing plant. Wait for 10 minutes in case additional parts need to be loaded, then return to the depot and stand by.

Proceed to the orchard to gather a basket of apples. Carry the basket to the juicing facility. After unloading, travel to the fuel station, wait there for 8 minutes to complete a recharge cycle, and end the routine at the control room.
Head to the equipment shed and collect two water hoses, then drive to the irrigation control station and wait until a worker unloads the hoses before departing.

Go to the seed storage bay and pick up three sacks of corn seeds. Transport the sacks to the Northwest Field Plot. While at the field, wait for 10 minutes to allow the planting crew to unload the seeds. After unloading, proceed to the rainwater tank area to pick up two empty water canisters and deliver them back to the equipment garage.

Travel to the north end of the vineyard to collect three empty water tanks. Transport all three tanks to the irrigation reservoir. Wait until the tanks are refilled, then deliver one filled tank each to the east field, the central orchard, and the greenhouse. Once all tanks have been delivered, proceed to the utility shed for stand-by instructions.

Travel to the north orchard and pick up three empty fruit baskets, then transport them to the equipment shed and wait until a worker signals that the baskets have been unloaded before returning to your charging station.

Proceed to the equipment yard and collect two fuel canisters. Deliver them to the irrigation control shed. After unloading, wait for 8 minutes to receive any empty canisters for return. Take any emptied canisters back to the equipment yard and complete the task there.
Proceed to the seed storage room and pick up two bags of fertilizer. Deliver them to the southern field, wait until a farm worker has removed both bags, then return to the garage.

Drive to the equipment shed and collect three spare hoses. Deliver these hoses to the irrigation control center, wait for 10 minutes while technicians perform checks, then proceed to the vineyard and await further loading instructions.

Drive to the greenhouse storage area and collect three sacks of potting soil. Transport them to the north orchard, and wait until the farm workers finish unloading the cargo. Next, proceed to the maintenance garage, pick up a tool kit, and deliver it to the vineyard shed before returning to the greenhouse storage.

Drive to the equipment bay to pick up a sealed container of antifreeze. Deliver the container to the irrigation pump house. Wait for 10 minutes while technicians refill the pump, then collect three empty water jugs from the pump house and return them to the equipment bay.

Drive to the vineyard supply shed and load three bags of organic fertilizer and four irrigation hose reels onto the robot. Proceed through the north gate towards the east vineyard block. Deliver all three bags of fertilizer alongside two hose reels to the east block maintenance area. Then, take the remaining two hose reels to the south vineyard block's storage point. Upon completing the deliveries, wait at the south block storage area for ten minutes in case any empty containers need to be returned to the supply shed. Finally, return to the vineyard supply shed and stand by for further tasks.
Proceed to the greenhouse, collect two trays of seedlings, deliver them to Plot 7, and wait until a worker removes the trays before returning to the courtyard.

Start in the greenhouse and collect three trays of tomato seedlings. Deliver these trays to plot section B3 in the field. Wait until the farm workers have finished transplanting, then go to the irrigation shed and pick up a replacement hose reel. Bring the hose reel to the maintenance bay, drop it off, and then return to the greenhouse for your next assignment.

Travel to the greenhouse and collect eight trays of seedlings. Deliver three trays to the north field, two trays to the east field, and three trays to the community garden shed in that order. After final delivery at the shed, wait until a staff member confirms receipt before returning to the central depot.

Proceed to the main greenhouse and collect two fertilizer bags. Deliver the bags to the irrigation control area, then wait for 10 minutes to allow workers to distribute the fertilizer. Once the waiting time is over, travel to the garage for your next assignment.
Proceed to the equipment shed and pick up two spools of irrigation tubing, then drive to field sector B and wait for 10 minutes to be unloaded by the maintenance crew.

Drive to the irrigation pump house to collect three replacement water filters. Transport the filters to the north orchard and wait until a technician has removed all filters from your payload compartment. Next, proceed to the entrance of the farm administrative office and remain there for 15 minutes in case additional supplies are needed before returning to the equipment shed.

Proceed to the greenhouse tool closet and pick up two trays of seedling pots. Deliver the trays to planting row 4 in the eastern field. After unloading, remain at the drop-off point for 10 minutes to allow field workers to reload your compartment with empty trays. Once reloaded, return to the greenhouse tool closet and wait until the trays are removed.

Start at the greenhouse entrance, proceed to the irrigation control center to collect a box of replacement sprinkler heads, deliver the box to field plot 6B, wait for 10 minutes while technicians install the parts, then continue on to the compost area for your next assignment.

Travel to greenhouse 3 and collect the empty planting trays. Deliver the trays to the sanitation station and wait for 10 minutes while they are cleaned. Once the cleaning is complete, pick up the sanitized trays and return them to greenhouse 3.
Drive to the greenhouse, pick up the tray of tomato seedlings, deliver the tray to planting field B, and wait for 10 minutes before returning to the equipment shed.

Navigate to the packaging facility and retrieve two sealed crates of blueberries. Deliver both crates to the refrigerated storage unit behind the main barn. Wait beside the storage entrance for 7 minutes to allow staff to confirm receipt of the delivery, and then return to the central charging station.

Travel to the equipment shed and pick up a stack of irrigation pipes. Deliver the pipes to the central vineyard, wait for 10 minutes while the workers unload the pipes, then proceed to the maintenance room for your next assignment.

Proceed to the solar field and collect three empty battery packs. Transport them to the charging shed and wait until all battery packs are fully recharged by the staff. Once the battery packs are loaded onto you again, return them to the solar field and place them in their charging units. After completing delivery, navigate to the shade area near the pond and remain stationary for 15 minutes to allow your systems to cool down before resuming operations.

Move to the compost storage area and retrieve two biodegradable waste bins. Deliver the bins to the southern greenhouse; wait until both bins have been unloaded from your platform. Once unloaded, continue to the garage and wait for 5 minutes to receive further instructions from the maintenance supervisor.

Navigate to the parts warehouse and collect a single crate containing replacement sprinkler heads. Transport the crate to Field Sector 3 and wait for the field technician to remove the crate from your platform. Once unloaded, proceed to the main maintenance area and stand by for 10 minutes in case additional delivery requests are needed.

Head to the maintenance garage and pick up two sealed containers of hydraulic fluid. Transport the containers to the east windmill station and wait for a technician to unload both containers. Once the unloading is complete, proceed to the feed storage barn, collect a bundle of empty feed sacks, and deliver them to the composting area at the southern edge of the facility. After placing the sacks in the designated drop zone, wait for 10 minutes in the shade corridor adjacent to the composting area before returning to the maintenance garage for your next assignment.

Travel to the battery charging station and wait for 10 minutes to ensure your battery is fully charged. Then proceed to the orchard entrance and pick up three empty harvest crates. Deliver these crates to Harvest Row B. After all crates have been removed by the farm crew, return to the maintenance shed and await further tasks.

Proceed to the solar array control station and pick up two boxes of cleaning supplies. Deliver these boxes to the south field maintenance tent and wait until a supervisor confirms the supplies have been unloaded. After unloading, navigate to the refueling station behind the workshop and remain on standby for 5 minutes before returning to the main staging area.

Start at the main warehouse and pick up two sealed containers of fertilizer. Transport these containers to the greenhouse area. Wait until greenhouse staff finish unloading the fertilizer, then return to the main warehouse for your next pickup.

Proceed to the tool storage container near the southeast greenhouse and collect the designated toolbox for the irrigation repair crew. Transport the toolbox to the pump station by the river. Wait until the repair crew has unloaded the toolbox, then move to the supply tent to pick up a rolled tarpaulin. Deliver the tarpaulin to Field Plot C, and after confirming delivery, return to the vehicle garage and park in the assigned bay.

Begin at the orchard storage shed and collect a stack of empty fruit baskets. Proceed to the southern apple grove, and wait for the baskets to be completely loaded with picked apples. Once the loading is finished, deliver the filled baskets to the packing station near the east entrance and wait there for 10 minutes for further instructions.

Begin at the main workshop and drive to the orchard’s north entrance. Pick up four crates of freshly harvested pears. Transport the crates to the refrigerated storage unit beside the fruit processing plant. After unloading the crates, continue to the vehicle charging station and wait there for 15 minutes to recharge before heading back to the main workshop.

Drive to the orchard and pick up two crates of ripe apples. Deliver the crates to the processing facility. Wait at the facility until the crates are unloaded by the staff, then proceed to the tool storage locker to retrieve a replacement irrigation nozzle. Transport the nozzle to the equipment repair tent and leave it with the maintenance crew. Finally, return to the main pathway and wait there for 10 minutes for your next assignment.

Drive to the fertilizer storage shed and pick up two sacks of organic fertilizer. Transport the sacks to Orchard Block B, where the field crew will unload them. After delivery, proceed to the equipment bay and wait there for 15 minutes in case additional supplies are needed before returning to the main operations hub.

Travel to the maintenance workshop and pick up a toolbox and one replacement wheel. Deliver both items to the north greenhouse entrance. Wait for 10 minutes while the repair team installs the new wheel and returns the empty toolbox. Once the toolbox has been returned to your cargo bay, drive back to the maintenance workshop and drop it off before parking in the charging area.

Proceed to the seed warehouse and collect three sacks of wheat seeds. Deliver the sacks to plot number 7 on the eastern field. Wait at plot 7 for the planting crew to finish unloading all sacks. Once unloading is complete, drive to the solar charging station near the south gate and remain there for 20 minutes to recharge before returning to the equipment bay for your next task.

Go to the maintenance workshop and pick up two boxes of spare tractor parts. Proceed to the field equipment staging area and wait until all parts have been removed by the maintenance crew. Then, travel to the staff break zone beside the west orchard and pause for 10 minutes to be available for potential quick redeployment, before returning to the main garage for routine diagnostics.

Proceed to the north orchard and collect three crates of harvested pears. Transport the crates to the cold storage facility near the irrigation pumps. Wait for 8 minutes while the storage team finishes unloading the crates. Once unloaded, travel to the tool shed behind the greenhouse, pick up a coiled hose, and deliver it to the main garden fountain area. After dropping off the hose, immediately return to the north orchard for further instructions.

Travel to the northern greenhouse and pick up a pallet of seed trays. Deliver the pallet to the seedling propagation area behind the main barn. Wait until the horticulture team finishes unloading all the trays. Once the robot is empty, proceed to the compost station near the east gate and pick up any empty compost bins that are ready for return. Drop the empty bins off at the waste sorting area and then head to the outdoor charging station for a 15-minute recharge before awaiting the next assignment.

Proceed to the tool storage locker adjacent to the repair shop. Pick up the box of replacement hydraulic fittings. Transport the box to the north field equipment bay. Wait until a mechanic removes the box from your payload platform, then return to the main operations tent and stand by for the next assignment.

Head to the seed storage facility and pick up a pallet containing assorted fertilizer bags. Transport the pallet to the greenhouse loading bay. Wait for 7 minutes as the greenhouse staff unload the fertilizer, then proceed to the eastern barn to await further instructions.

Drive to the orchard’s west entrance and collect four crates of harvested peaches. Transport the crates to the refrigerated storage facility, and wait for a staff member to verify the crate labels. Once verification is complete, deliver the empty crates to the washing station behind the greenhouse. After the crates are unloaded at the washing station, proceed to the charging bay and await further tasks.

Begin at the maintenance garage and drive to the parts warehouse. Pick up two hydraulic pump assemblies and an oil filter from the loading area. Deliver all items to the tractor repair station in the north yard. Wait until a technician confirms all components have been unloaded. Then proceed to the west orchard and stand by under the equipment shelter for your next assignment.

Drive to the fertilizer storage barn and collect four bags of seed. Transport the seed to plot C in the eastern field and wait for 10 minutes while the planting crew unloads the bags. Once the bags are removed, proceed to the irrigation pump station to pick up a replacement filter cartridge. Deliver the cartridge to the greenhouse loading dock and wait until a technician removes it from your cargo platform before returning to the equipment garage.

Proceed to the fertilizer depot and pick up three bags of organic fertilizer. Deliver the bags to the western cornfield and wait until the farm manager confirms the delivery. After confirmation, continue to the charging station near the windmill, dock for a 15-minute recharge cycle, and then travel to the irrigation pump house to await further tasks.

Drive to the vineyard entrance and pick up a crate of empty harvest baskets. Deliver the crate to Row 12 of the grape orchard, then wait for 10 minutes while harvest workers fill the baskets. Once the baskets are full, transport them to the cooling shed near the north gate and wait until all baskets have been unloaded before proceeding to the equipment shed for your next assignment.

Proceed to the greenhouse and collect four trays of young tomato seedlings. Transport the trays to Plot 7 in the eastern cultivation field and wait until the planting crew has unloaded all trays from your platform. Next, travel to the maintenance bay to pick up a container of fertilizer pellets. Deliver the container to the composting station and notify the staff by waiting until they retrieve the fertilizer. Upon completion, return to the main charging station and remain there for 20 minutes to recharge your batteries before your next assignment.

Proceed to the maintenance garage and collect the toolkit case. Deliver the toolkit to the northern wind turbine inspection site. Wait at the site for up to 12 minutes while the maintenance crew uses the tools, then retrieve the toolkit and return it to the maintenance garage.

Travel to the orchard and pick up two crates of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the crates to the packing shed and wait for farm workers to unload them. Next, proceed to the fuel depot to pick up a sealed canister of diesel. Transport the canister to the tractor shed and remain there for 15 minutes while the tractor is being refueled. Once the waiting period is over, return to the logistics center and await further instructions.

Drive to the greenhouse supply shed and pick up three trays of seedling pots. Deliver the trays to the north orchard's irrigation system for planting. Wait until a worker confirms that all trays have been unloaded. Then, proceed to the machinery charging bay for a routine battery recharge and stay there for 15 minutes before returning to the greenhouse supply shed to prepare for your next collection.

Go to the solar charging station near the tool shed and pick up the crate of battery packs. Deliver the crate to the maintenance workshop. Wait for 15 minutes while the maintenance crew installs the fresh batteries and places old battery packs on your platform. Once loaded with the old batteries, transport them to the hazardous materials storage area and wait until a supervisor removes them before returning to the solar charging station.

Drive to the chemical storage shed and pick up two safety-marked fertilizer canisters. Transport the canisters to the greenhouse entrance. Wait until a team member confirms receipt of the canisters. Once the handover is verified, return to the logistics hub for further instructions.

Drive to the greenhouse annex and pick up three trays of young tomato seedlings. Deliver the trays to field plot C and wait up to 20 minutes while workers distribute the seedlings in the prepared beds.
