Bring the filter cartridge to the irrigation control cabin and remain there until the technician arrives and collects the item. Once unloaded, return to the service yard for your next assignment.

Proceed to the spare parts depot and collect a box of irrigation valve components. Transport the box to the central vineyard maintenance area and wait until a technician removes the box from your payload bay. After the delivery, return to the vehicle charging station and remain there until your battery is fully recharged.

Travel to the main barn storage area and pick up two sacks of animal feed. Deliver the sacks to the livestock corral feeding station. Wait for a farmhand to unload the animal feed from your platform. After the feed is unloaded, proceed to the west field's equipment staging zone and collect a toolbox. Bring the toolbox to the tractor garage and wait until a mechanic removes it before returning to the main barn storage area.

Start by navigating to the grain storage barn and retrieving two sealed bags of livestock feed. Transport these bags to the west pasture feeding station. Wait up to 15 minutes while the farmhands unload the feed bags onto the storage pallets. Once the unloading is complete, proceed to the equipment rental shed and pick up a replacement hydraulic hose. Deliver the hose to the tractor repair bay inside the main machinery garage. After the item has been collected by the mechanic, return to the central dispatch area and remain there for the next assignment.

Proceed to the maintenance yard and collect a pallet of spare solar panels. Transport the pallet to the south end of Field B, where the solar monitoring team is stationed. Wait until the team has completely unloaded the solar panels from your platform. After unloading, return to the water pump station to await further instructions.

Head to the orchard's packing shed and pick up three crates of freshly picked apples. Deliver these crates to the market loading zone near the east gate. Wait for the produce manager to inspect and sign off on the delivery, which may take up to 10 minutes. Once approved, travel to the recycling station and collect an empty collection bin. Bring the empty bin to the greenhouse entrance, place it nearby, and return to the orchard's packing shed to await your next assignment.

Proceed to the supply depot and collect six containers of lubricant oil. Deliver the containers to the tractor maintenance bay and wait until all containers have been unloaded by the mechanics. Next, travel to the south vineyard and pick up two crates of harvested grapes. Transport these crates to the cold storage facility and stand by for 5 minutes to allow for automated quality inspection before returning to the central control station.

Begin at the equipment garage and proceed to the irrigation pond. Collect four empty water drums from the collection point. Transport the drums to the crop field B. Wait for 10 minutes while staff refill the drums with irrigation water. After loading is complete, deliver the full drums to the orchard’s water distribution area. Once all drums are unloaded by the orchard team, return to the equipment garage for your next task.

Proceed to the vineyard storage area and collect a pallet containing six bundles of trellis wires. Deliver the pallet to Field Section D, where the trellis installation crew is working. Wait at Field Section D until the crew has unloaded all bundles from the pallet. Next, navigate to the pesticide storage shed and pick up a sealed container of organic spray solution. Transport the container to the east-side crop treatment zone. After ensuring the container has been safely handed over to the agronomist, return to the operations hub and await further instructions for 12 minutes.

Start at the main workshop and drive to the eastern greenhouse. Pick up a crate of replacement seedlings from the staff at the greenhouse entrance. Transport the crate to the plant nursery in the central compound. Once there, wait until the nursery technician has confirmed reception and removed the crate. Then proceed to the compost yard, remain there for 8 minutes to allow maintenance staff to load garden tools onto your cargo bed, and finally return to the main workshop for unloading.

Navigate to the irrigation pump station and collect two replacement water filters. Bring the filters to the south field storage tent. Wait for a technician to remove the old filters and install the new ones—a process that may take up to 8 minutes—then return the used filters to the waste disposal area beside the workshop before reporting back to the irrigation pump station for your next task.

Start at the parts warehouse and collect a pallet of replacement air filters. Transport the pallet to the greenhouse service entrance and wait until all filters have been unloaded. After unloading, proceed to the irrigation control shed and pick up a sealed container of calibration sensors. Deliver the sensors to the orchard’s south gate monitoring station, then wait for 7 minutes for further instructions before returning to the parts warehouse.

Travel to storage barn C and pick up two crates of engine spare parts. Deliver the crates to the maintenance workshop at the west lot and wait for the mechanic to place used parts onto your platform. Once the used parts are loaded, proceed to the waste disposal center behind the irrigation pond and unload the materials as instructed. Finally, head to the main entrance checkpoint and stand by for 10 minutes before proceeding to your next task.

Begin at the central supplies depot and collect three sealed containers of fertilizer. Proceed to the east orchard and deliver the containers near the irrigation control shed. Wait until all containers are unloaded by the staff, then move to the refueling station adjacent to the tractor garage. Wait for 8 minutes to be refueled, and, once complete, return to the supplies depot for your next assignment.

Navigate to the greenhouse annex and pick up two crates of seedling trays. Transport the trays to Plot C in the northern orchard and deliver them to the planting team. After the seedlings have been unloaded, wait by the tool storage area for 5 minutes to assist with potential returns of empty crates. Once the wait is complete, proceed to the compost pile and remain on standby until further instructions are given.

Proceed to the seed storage facility and retrieve four bags of drought-resistant corn seed. Deliver the bags to Planting Field 3 and wait until the field supervisor has confirmed that all seeds have been unloaded. Afterward, drive to the maintenance workshop and pick up a toolbox for routine equipment repairs. Transport the toolbox to the vineyard’s west gate and wait for 10 minutes to allow the maintenance team to finish their inspection before returning to the seed storage facility.

Start at the equipment storage barn and pick up two reels of irrigation hose. Transport both reels to Vineyard Block C and wait until the vineyard crew unloads them from your platform. Once the reels have been removed, proceed to the packing shed to retrieve a weatherproof toolbox. Deliver the toolbox to the wind turbine maintenance outpost. Wait for 5 minutes at the outpost to allow technicians time to collect and inspect the toolbox before returning to the equipment storage barn.

Proceed to the loading dock at the west end of the facility and pick up four boxes of irrigation pipe fittings. Drive these boxes to the central pump house, where a crew member will unload the items. Wait until all boxes have been removed, then continue to the equipment shed behind the warehouse and collect a spare battery pack. Transport the battery pack to the vineyard outpost, deliver it to the charging station, and wait for 7 minutes in the shaded awning before returning to the main loading dock.

Travel to the chemical supply depot and pick up three containers of liquid fertilizer. Transport these containers to the irrigation control station near the south field. Wait up to 10 minutes for the field supervisor to offload and check the inventory. After confirmation, proceed to the solar maintenance yard and collect a box of photovoltaic panel cleaning kits. Deliver the cleaning kits to the maintenance hut by the wind turbine array, and remain outside the hut for 5 minutes in case additional tools need to be retrieved before returning to the chemical supply depot.
Proceed to the greenhouse entrance and collect three trays of tomato seedlings, then transport them and deliver the trays to the northern plot planting zone.

Go to the greenhouse to pick up the pallet of fertilizer bags. Deliver the pallet to the eastern field shed. Once unloaded, proceed to the equipment shelter and wait until the irrigation drone is placed onto the robot. Transport the drone to the launch pad, unload it, and remain at the launch pad for 15 minutes before returning to the greenhouse.
Travel to the irrigation shed, collect two containers of fertilizer, deliver them to the east vineyard, wait until a worker unloads the containers, then return to the maintenance bay.

Proceed to the central storage tent and pick up three sealed crates of beehive frames. Deliver the crates to the apiary workbench in the north orchard. After the frames have been unloaded by the crew, wait for 10 minutes for any urgent deliveries. Subsequently, travel to the maintenance garage and await further loading instructions.

Drive to the greenhouse and collect a basket of harvested cucumbers. Deliver the basket to the produce sorting area. Wait until the basket is fully unloaded, then proceed to the storage shed to pick up two irrigation hoses and transport them to the northern field.

Drive to the loading dock and pick up three sealed barrels of irrigation fluid. Transport the barrels to the south field station, and wait while farm staff inspect the delivery. Once the barrels are unloaded, proceed to the equipment garage to collect a toolbox, and then deliver the toolbox to the north maintenance shack before returning to the charging station.

Proceed to the eastern orchard equipment shed to pick up two replacement irrigation hoses. Deliver the hoses to the north field pump station. Wait until a technician has installed the hoses and signaled completion. After receiving confirmation, travel to the farm's chemical storage area to collect three containers of fertilizer, then bring them to the southern vineyard loading dock and await further instructions.

Proceed to the orchard packing station and pick up three baskets of harvested pears. Deliver them to the quality control lab and wait until the inspector unloads the baskets. Once empty, travel to the solar equipment shed to collect a box of replacement solar panels, then deliver it to the maintenance field near the greenhouse. After unloading, return to the orchard packing station and stand by for five minutes before resuming further assignments.

Proceed to the greenhouse annex and retrieve four trays of seedling plants. Deliver two trays to the northern irrigation hub and place them on the designated rack. Bring the remaining two trays to the eastern planting plot. Once all trays have been delivered, wait for 10 minutes to confirm successful transfer, then return to the field operations tent.

Head to the equipment shed to collect three bags of biodegradable fertilizer. Transport one bag each to the west apple grove, central strawberry patch, and south vegetable rows. At each stop, wait for 7 minutes while the farm hands distribute the fertilizer, then proceed to the next location. Once all deliveries are completed, return to the equipment shed and stand by for further assignment.

Proceed to the fertilizer storage room, pick up two bags of organic fertilizer, deliver them to the north field, wait for the field supervisor to approve the delivery, then return to the maintenance shed.

Go to the fertilizer shed and pick up two bags of organic fertilizer. Transport the bags to greenhouse 4. Once you arrive, wait until all bags are removed by the horticulture team. Then travel to the field office and remain there for 15 minutes to assist staff with any quick requests. Finally, return to the main charging station.

Proceed to the loading dock to pick up three crates of freshly harvested tomatoes, deliver the crates to the packaging facility, wait for 10 minutes while workers inspect the load, and afterward make your way to the fuel station for recharging.
Drive to the maintenance shed, pick up two spare engine belts, deliver them to the grain silo, and wait until a technician retrieves the belts from the robot before returning to the maintenance shed.

Proceed to the orchard entrance and collect a stack of harvesting baskets. Transport the baskets to picking zone B. After all baskets are unloaded by the harvesting crew, wait for 10 minutes in the shade near the water station in case additional baskets are required. Once you receive confirmation that your assistance is no longer needed, make your way to the equipment garage for routine inspection.

Navigate to the irrigation control shed and collect two replacement water pumps. Deliver the pumps to the east field pump station. Once the maintenance crew has removed the old equipment and signaled readiness, wait for 8 minutes to ensure successful installation before returning to the tool storage bay.

Travel to the orchard's north gate and pick up two bins of apples. Deliver the bins to the cold storage room. Wait until both bins are unloaded by staff. Next, proceed to the maintenance garage and wait for the replacement battery pack to be loaded onto the robot. Take the battery pack to the solar charging station, unload it, and then return to the orchard's north gate.

Travel to the maintenance shed and retrieve two spare fuel canisters. Convey the canisters to field generator station 3 near the south fence. Wait until all canisters have been transferred by the technician, and then proceed to the nearby tool depot to assist with relocating a pallet of gardening tools to the irrigation control room. After the delivery is complete, return to the charging area for battery replenishment.

Proceed to the seed sorting facility and collect three sacks of corn seeds. Transport the sacks to the planting field entrance and wait until all sacks are removed by the planting crew. After delivery, head to the irrigation pump station and stay for 20 minutes to monitor water levels. Then, return to the seed sorting facility to assist with additional tasks as needed.

Drive to the spare parts depot and pick up one crate of hydraulic fittings. Deliver the crate to the tractor parking zone. Wait for 10 minutes to allow the maintenance crew to unload the crate. Afterwards, proceed to the tool storage locker and remain there for 15 minutes to await further loading instructions.

Proceed to the vegetable packing zone and collect three crates of tomatoes. Deliver the crates to cold storage room 2 in the warehouse building. Once unloaded, wait for 10 minutes to assist with any additional incoming produce. Afterwards, return to the central loading bay to stand by for further instructions.

Head to the orchard’s north gate and collect a sack of pruning tools. Transport the sack to the vineyard maintenance tent. Once there, wait for 15 minutes while the crew inspects the equipment. After the waiting period, return to the orchard supply depot and await further loading.

Begin by traveling to the orchard equipment shed to pick up a set of replacement pruning shears. Deliver the pruning shears to the north orchard section. Once unloaded, wait for 8 minutes to allow workers to test the equipment. Afterward, proceed to the compost area to retrieve a container of organic waste and transport it to the recycling center. Upon delivery, return to the central charging point and stand by for further instructions.

Travel to the irrigation supply depot and pick up two coiled hoses and a control valve. Transport these items to the field operations center. After drop-off, wait for 5 minutes to confirm the equipment is functional, then proceed to the forklift bay to retrieve an empty pallet. Deliver the empty pallet to the greenhouse loading zone and remain there until it has been loaded with potted seedlings before returning to the irrigation supply depot.

Navigate to the tool depot near the southwest field, pick up a canister of lubricating oil and a toolbox. Deliver both items to the windmill service area. Wait for the maintenance crew to unload the items, then proceed to the refueling station by the service gate and remain there for 15 minutes before heading back to the storage garage.

Navigate to the central orchard and collect three crates of harvested peaches. Bring the crates to the cold storage tent near the northern gate. Wait for the quality control inspector to verify the delivery before proceeding to the composting area. At the composting area, pick up an empty waste bin and transport it back to the central orchard. Once the waste bin has been dropped off, return to the equipment garage and await further instructions.

Head to the workshop storage area and pick up three sealed containers labeled 'Hazardous Waste.' Proceed carefully to the designated disposal site at the eastern perimeter. Upon arrival, wait until authorized personnel unload all containers. Once the payload is confirmed removed, drive to the equipment wash station and wait for 10 minutes for a thorough cleaning before returning to the workshop storage area.

Travel to the orchard’s northeast corner and gather all baskets filled with ripe pears. Carefully transport the baskets to the sorting shed beside the main barn. Once there, wait until the fruit sorting crew has emptied all baskets. As soon as the robot is empty, proceed to the solar charging station behind the equipment garage and recharge for 20 minutes before resuming any further tasks.

Begin at the main storage silo and pick up two bags of fertilizer. Deliver the bags to the south field’s supply point. Upon arrival, wait for the field assistant to unload both bags. Next, travel to the maintenance shed near the tractor parking area to collect a box of replacement spray nozzles. Take the box to the pesticide mixing station beside the west irrigation canal. Wait for 10 minutes while the technical team installs the nozzles, then proceed to the equipment garage for further instructions.

Start at the supply depot and load three crates of fresh sensors onto the robot. Transport the crates to the north greenhouse entrance. Once there, wait until all crates are removed by the greenhouse staff. Then, proceed to the composting station at the southwest corner of the farm and pick up a sealed container of compost samples. Deliver the container to the laboratory building. Upon delivery, wait outside the laboratory for 15 minutes in case any samples need to be returned. After the wait, travel to the solar charging station for recharge.

Travel to the maintenance garage and pick up two spare hydraulic hoses. Deliver the hoses to the greenhouse repair site and wait until the technician has unloaded both hoses. After unloading, proceed to the solar charging station and remain there for 15 minutes to recharge batteries before returning to the maintenance garage.

Proceed to the supply warehouse next to the greenhouse and collect three seed trays. Transport the seed trays to the central planting plot. Wait at the plot until all trays have been received by the planting supervisor, then continue to the vehicle wash bay for cleaning before returning to the parking zone near the main entrance.

Proceed to the composting site near the west fence and collect any full bio-waste bins. Deliver these bins to the recycling depot at the north entrance. After unloading, travel to the pesticide storage room, wait until a sealed canister is loaded onto the robot, and then promptly transfer the canister to the vine field utility station. Drop off the canister, wait for 8 minutes to confirm safe delivery, and finally return to the composting site for the next task.

Proceed to the vineyard supply shed and pick up a pallet of irrigation pipe fittings. Deliver the pallet to Plot C in the northern vineyard zone. Upon arrival, wait for 8 minutes while the crew verifies the delivery, then head to the equipment wash bay for a full exterior cleaning before returning to standby at the operations center.

Start at the packaging facility and pick up three crates of freshly harvested lettuce. Drive to the east distribution depot and deliver the lettuce crates. After delivering, wait for 15 minutes to be loaded with empty plastic crates by the depot staff. Once loaded, return to the main field’s collection zone and unload all empty crates for the harvest crew. Finally, proceed to the refueling station next to the barn and wait for refueling before powering down.

Drive to the north orchard entry gate and wait for the harvest crew to load an unspecified quantity of apple crates onto the platform. Once loading is complete, transport the apple crates to Packing Facility 2. Wait at the loading bay until all crates have been unloaded by facility staff, then proceed immediately to the fuel station for refueling before returning to the north orchard entry gate.

Drive to the irrigation pump station and pick up two reels of hose. Transport the hoses to Vineyard Row 7 and leave them at the marked drop-off area. Proceed to the nearby equipment storage hut to retrieve a box of replacement nozzles, then deliver these nozzles to the maintenance tent. Wait for 5 minutes for the maintenance crew to unload the nozzles before heading back to the charging dock.

Drive to the orchard collection point and pick up two full baskets of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the baskets to the cold storage facility and wait for 10 minutes while the apples are unloaded. Afterwards, proceed to the compost area and collect a container of organic waste, then drop it off at the greenhouse composting station before returning to the main garage.

Head to the parts depot and pick up three replacement sensors. Deliver the sensors to the vineyard maintenance station. Wait until all sensors have been unloaded, then continue to the tools workshop to collect a set of pruning shears and transfer them to the orchard supervisor’s office.

Travel to the equipment storage shed to collect three irrigation pumps. Deliver one pump to the south greenhouse, another to the central crop field's edge, and the third to the northern orchard outpost. After each delivery, wait until the pump has been fully unloaded before proceeding to the next location. Once all pumps are delivered, return to the storage shed for further instructions.

Drive to the fertilizer storage shed and pick up three sacks of organic compost. Proceed to the west greenhouse and deliver two sacks by the main entrance. Next, take the remaining sack to the irrigation control center and wait outside for five minutes while staff inspect the delivery. When inspection is complete, continue to the maintenance bay for your next assignment.

Head to the vineyard storage shed and pick up three crates of grape samples. Deliver the first crate to the fermentation lab, the second to the quality control office, and the third to the bottling line. Once the final delivery is complete, wait for 20 minutes near the bottling line in case any sample retrievals are needed, then proceed to the fleet charging station to end the task.

Proceed to the solar panel field and collect a batch of twelve damaged solar cells. Take six cells to the maintenance tent for immediate repairs, leaving them there. Deliver the remaining six cells to the recycling bay next to the east gate. Once the cells are unloaded at the recycling bay, wait for 10 minutes in case any additional recyclable materials need to be loaded onto the robot before returning to the central garage.

Proceed to the windmill maintenance bay to pick up a toolkit and two replacement fan blades. Transport the entire payload to Windmill 7 on the east field. Wait for the maintenance crew to unload the items and signal that repair preparations are complete. Once cleared, return to the main garage and await standby instructions.

Drive to the fruit orchard and collect eight crates of harvested pears from under the storage canopy. Transport four crates to the main distribution center, wait for 5 minutes while the crates are checked in, then proceed with the remaining four crates to the local farmer's market booth. After the pears are fully unloaded at the booth, wait until you are loaded with any returned empty crates. Return these empty crates to the orchard storage canopy before heading back to the equipment shed.

Drive to the composting facility and pick up three empty fertilizer bins. Deliver one bin each to Greenhouse 2, the Orchard Equipment Shed, and the North Field Tool Station in any order. Wait at the North Field Tool Station for 10 minutes to be reloaded with tools, then return all unused bins to the composting facility.
Proceed to the supply shed, collect three bags of fertilizer, bring them to the orchard tool station, wait until the bags have been fully unloaded by staff, then head back to the charging station.

Drive to the south orchard and pick up three baskets of apples. Transport them to the cold storage facility and wait to be unloaded. After delivery, proceed to the equipment shed and wait there for 8 minutes before returning to the control center.

Drive to the irrigation pump house, pick up two replacement filters, deliver them to the maintenance tent, wait for 10 minutes while technicians swap the old filters, then return to the central dispatch area.

Drive to the maintenance garage to collect two containers of hydraulic oil, then transport them to the east side irrigation pump station and wait there until the containers are unloaded before returning to the maintenance garage.
Drive to the maintenance shed, collect two spare hydraulic hoses, and deliver them to the tractor repair bay.
Go to the chemical storage shed, collect two fertilizer containers, deliver them to the northern greenhouse, and wait until they are unloaded before returning to the equipment shelter.

Proceed to the irrigation pump station and collect the water testing kit. Deliver the kit to the greenhouse lab for sampling and remain there until the lab technician removes it. After the delivery, travel to the east field supply depot, pick up two bags of fertilizer, and transport them to field section B. Wait in field section B for 15 minutes to monitor deployment before returning to the operations garage.

Head to the greenhouse supply shed and pick up three bags of fertilizer. Deliver the bags to the south crop field and wait until all the bags have been removed before proceeding to the water reservoir and waiting for 10 minutes.

Drive to the maintenance depot and pick up two sealed toolboxes. Proceed to the north equipment station and deliver both toolboxes. Wait at the north equipment station for the empty toolboxes to be returned to you, then transport the empty toolboxes back to the maintenance depot.

Travel to the orchard entrance and pick up three baskets of freshly harvested apples. Deliver the apple baskets to the cold storage building. Once delivered, wait next to the facility for 8 minutes for any additional baskets of apples that might need transport. If additional baskets are provided within the waiting period, load them onto the robot and return to the cold storage building to deliver them again.

Travel to the greenhouse entrance, pick up a pallet of empty seed trays, transport them to the planting field staging area, wait for 10 minutes while workers distribute the trays, and then proceed to the fuel depot.

Travel to the greenhouse supply area and collect three cases of seedling trays. Bring the seedling trays to Plot B at the south field. Wait at Plot B for 10 minutes for the trays to be unloaded, then return to the greenhouse supply area.

Navigate to the northwest greenhouse, pick up three trays of tomato seedlings, deliver them to the planting fields section B, and wait for 10 minutes while the trays are emptied before proceeding to the supply shed for the next assignment.

Proceed to the equipment depot and pick up two sealed containers of pesticide, then transport them directly to the vineyard’s northern gate. Wait at the gate until the farm technician removes both containers before returning to the equipment depot for further assignments.

Drive to the tool shed, collect three containers of fertilizer, deliver them to irrigation point B, wait until all containers have been removed from the robot, then continue to the battery charging station.
Drive to the machinery shed, collect two cans of motor oil, transport them to the tractor parking area, and wait there for 10 minutes before returning to the machinery shed.

Proceed to the equipment depot to pick up three spare tractor wheels, then deliver them to the machine yard storage area. Wait at the storage area for 12 minutes before returning to the equipment depot.

Proceed to the greenhouse supply area, collect two trays of tomato seedlings, deliver them to row 7 in the east field, wait for the farm staff to unload the trays, then return to the greenhouse supply area for the next assignment.
Go to the greenhouse supply depot, pick up a bin of fertilizer bags, deliver them to Field 4’s north entrance, and wait there for 10 minutes before heading back to the central command post.

Travel to the tool depot and collect two boxes of spare parts. Deliver the boxes to the northern maintenance station. Wait for the parts to be unloaded, then head to the fuel station and remain there until refueling is complete before proceeding to the main gate.

Travel to the maintenance shed and pick up a set of four replacement air filters, then proceed to the irrigation control station. Wait until a technician retrieves the air filters before returning to the maintenance shed.

Drive to the orchard entrance and collect four empty harvest baskets. Transport the baskets to picking zone C in the apple orchard. Wait until all baskets are filled by the orchard workers, then deliver the filled baskets to the cold storage facility. Once unloaded, return to the orchard entrance for further tasks.

Travel to the equipment shed and pick up two sealed containers of pesticide. Proceed to the southern edge of the sunflower field and wait for the farm supervisor to unlock the spray gate. After gaining access, deliver both containers next to the main irrigation line. Wait until the containers are unloaded by the supervisor, then continue to the garage for the next maintenance check.

Drive to the greenhouse supply room to pick up a pallet of seed trays. Transport the pallet to the north end of the nursery field. After arriving, wait 8 minutes until the horticulture team retrieves and unloads the seed trays. Next, make your way to the compost storage area and collect one empty waste bin. Deliver the waste bin outside the equipment wash station and stand by for up to 12 minutes until the cleaning crew fills it with debris. Once loaded, return the bin to the compost storage area.

Drive to the fertilizer storage barn and pick up three sacks of granulated fertilizer. Head to Field Plot B and deliver all fertilizer sacks to the field crew. Wait at Field Plot B for 10 minutes to receive any empty fertilizer bags, then return the empty bags to the fertilizer storage barn.

Drive to the orchard packing station and pick up two crates of freshly harvested apples. Transport the crates to the cold storage facility near the irrigation pond. Wait at the cold storage for the crates to be unloaded before proceeding to the maintenance shed.

Proceed to the orchard entrance and collect a single crate of harvested apples. Transport the crate to the packaging facility and wait until the crate has been unloaded. Once unloaded, return to the orchard entrance and stand by for further instructions.

Go to the greenhouse equipment bay, pick up the pallet of irrigation hoses, deliver it to the south field access gate, and wait for 10 minutes while the field crew unloads the pallet. After the pallet is unloaded, proceed to the fuel depot for your next assignment.

Drive to the maintenance shed and pick up two containers of engine oil. Deliver the containers to the tractor garage. Wait there for 10 minutes for the maintenance crew to retrieve the containers. Once they are unloaded, proceed to the equipment storage yard and stand by for new loading tasks.

Travel to the orchard packing station and pick up three crates of harvested pears. Deliver the crates to the cold storage facility. Wait at the cold storage facility until the crates are unloaded—this should not exceed 7 minutes. After delivery, proceed to the irrigation control shed, collect a box of spare drip line fittings, and bring them to Field Section C for the irrigation technicians to access. Once the box is delivered, wait in Field Section C for further instructions.

Proceed to the maintenance garage and pick up two containers of hydraulic fluid. Transport the containers to the vineyard maintenance zone, where the service crew is waiting. Wait at the delivery location until the containers are removed, allowing up to 12 minutes for unloading. Once your cargo is unloaded, return to the equipment garage and await further dispatch.

Head to the western barn and pick up two barrels of livestock feed. Deliver the barrels to the animal enclosure gate. Wait for 6 minutes while the feed is transferred by the caretakers. After unloading, travel to the mechanics bay and collect a toolbox. Take the toolbox to the solar panel field control hut, and wait until a technician retrieves it before returning to the main service depot.

Proceed to the main greenhouse and collect five trays of young tomato plants. Drive to Orchard Zone C and deliver all trays of tomato plants to the planting crew. Wait at Orchard Zone C for the empty trays to be loaded back onto the robot, then return with the empty trays to the main greenhouse.

Proceed to the fuel storage depot and pick up two sealed fuel canisters. Transport the canisters to the irrigation pump station by the east field. Wait there until a technician confirms the canisters are unloaded. Next, navigate to the spare parts container near the mechanics’ tent and wait for 8 minutes while maintenance staff load a set of replacement filters onto the robot. Once loaded, deliver the filters to the filtration unit near the reservoir, then return to the fuel storage depot to stand by for new instructions.

Proceed to the equipment locker near the north entrance and collect four protective gear kits. Transport the gear kits to the pesticide mixing station beside the east orchard. Wait until a supervisor verifies the delivery and removes at least two kits, then continue to the fuel depot to pick up a replacement fuel canister. Deliver the fuel canister to the generator shelter at the irrigation control area, and stand by for 8 minutes before heading back to the equipment locker.

Proceed to the greenhouse entrance and pick up three trays of newly sprouted seedlings. Deliver the trays to plot section B in the eastern orchard. Wait for a worker to remove all trays before navigating to the equipment garage and remain there for 10 minutes to allow a system diagnostic check. Afterward, return to the central command post.

Head to the spare parts container near the main barn and pick up two sealed boxes of tractor filters. Navigate to the machinery repair shed and deliver the boxes. Wait until the maintenance team removes both boxes from your platform, then remain on standby for 5 minutes before returning to the central dispatch area for further instructions.

Drive to Barn 3 and pick up two crates of harvested tomatoes. Navigate to the farmers’ market loading area and deliver the tomato crates. Wait until the vendor unloads both crates, then proceed to the tool storage cabin adjacent to the rice field. Collect a single bag of replacement drip-line hoses and transport it to  Field 7 at the western boundary. Wait for 12 minutes while field workers install the hoses, then return to Barn 3.

Head to the greenhouse workshop and pick up a sealed canister of plant nutrients. Deliver the canister to the field research plot located at the eastern edge of the farm. Wait in the research plot area until a technician retrieves the canister; this should take no longer than 10 minutes. Afterwards, proceed to the main barn to collect any empty nutrient containers for return to the greenhouse workshop.

Navigate to the greenhouse, pick up three trays of tomato seedlings, and deliver them to planting plot B at the south end of the farm. After delivery, wait for 15 minutes to allow the field workers to unload the trays. Once unloading is complete, proceed to the compost area and stand by for further tasks.

Head to the equipment storage shed to pick up a single heavy-duty battery pack. Deliver the battery pack to the solar monitoring station located at the edge of Field 7. Wait at the station for 10 minutes to allow the maintenance team to fit the battery, then return to the equipment storage shed.

Travel to the greenhouse loading zone and pick up three crates of fresh seedlings. Deliver the crates to the planting site at plot 7 near the north orchard. Wait for 5 minutes while farm workers unload the seedlings. Afterwards, proceed to the equipment shed at the west edge of the property and collect a toolbox. Transport the toolbox to the maintenance area beside the solar panel array and wait until a technician removes it from the robot before returning to the greenhouse loading zone.

Start by driving to the solar equipment shed near the south orchard. Pick up three sealed battery packs from the shed. Transport the battery packs to the irrigation controller station by the eastern pond. Wait until a technician unloads all three battery packs and confirms receipt. Afterwards, proceed to the maintenance garage for further assignments.

Drive to the orchard north entrance and pick up four empty harvest baskets. Proceed to apple row 5 and wait for pickers to fill the baskets, allowing up to 18 minutes for loading. Once filled, transport the baskets to the packing station, deliver them to the loading ramp, and return to the orchard base for your next task.

Proceed to the north field storage barn and pick up two sacks of fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to the vegetable plot entrance. Wait for 15 minutes while the sacks are unloaded by the field crew. Once unloading is complete, return to the equipment charging station next to the central farm office.

Drive to the maintenance shed and pick up two containers of spare tractor parts. Transport the containers to the machinery workshop located next to the west storage barn. Wait at the workshop until both containers have been unloaded by a technician. After the unloading is complete, proceed to the vehicle charging station and wait there for 20 minutes to recharge before returning to the operations office.

Proceed to the spare parts depot near the north maintenance gate and pick up two boxes of replacement gears. Deliver these boxes to the machinery repair bay inside the main workshop building. Wait at the repair bay until all boxes have been unloaded, then head over to the solar charging station and recharge for 15 minutes before resuming your next assignment.

Drive to the orchard entrance and pick up a pallet of freshly harvested apples. Transport the pallet to the cold storage facility, and wait for 10 minutes while staff members record the delivery and unload the apples. Once the pallet has been unloaded, proceed to the maintenance garage for diagnostics before your next task.

Start at the grain processing warehouse and pick up one pallet of seed bags. Drive to greenhouse number 3 and deliver the pallet at the supply platform. Wait until the greenhouse staff have unloaded all seed bags from the robot, then proceed to the maintenance garage for inspection.

Start by navigating to the greenhouse supply depot and pick up two sealed containers of fertilizer. Deliver the containers to the east greenhouse and wait for a horticulturist to unload them, remaining onsite for up to 10 minutes. Once the containers are received, proceed to the composting area and stand by for future instructions.

Travel to the spare parts shed and pick up one container of mechanical fasteners. Drive to the wind turbine maintenance platform at the edge of the field, deliver the container, and wait until the maintenance crew has unloaded all fasteners. Afterward, return to the main garage and stand by for 10 minutes.

Proceed to the fertilization depot and retrieve three bags of nitrogen fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer bags to Plot 12 in the eastern crop field. Wait until the farm staff unload all the bags, then navigate to the nearby water refill station and stand by for 5 minutes before returning to the central control hub.

Drive to the greenhouse supply room and pick up three bags of fertilizer. Navigate to the southern field near irrigation canal 2 and deliver the bags to the supervisor. Wait at the delivery point for 5 minutes for the field crew to verify delivery. Once acknowledged, return to the equipment bay next to the north parking lot.

Travel to the packing barn at the east orchard and pick up a crate of freshly harvested apples. Proceed to the quality control station beside the main sorting line. Wait until the quality inspector empties the crate from the robot. Once the crate has been removed, navigate to the wash-down area outside the barn for cleaning before awaiting further instructions.

Travel to the solar panel array at the northern edge of the facility and collect the maintenance toolkit. Deliver the toolkit to the electrical substation beside the grain silos. Wait for the repair crew to finish using the toolkit and return it to your cargo platform. Once the toolkit is loaded back onto the robot, transport it to the equipment garage and wait for it to be unloaded before returning to standby mode at the central dispatch area.

Proceed to the chemical storage bunker near the irrigation pond and collect three sealed drums of fertilizer. Transport the drums to the central greenhouse supply entrance. Wait until the facility manager confirms the drums have been unloaded. Afterward, return to the base station in the northeast corner of the farmyard and remain on standby for the next assignment.

Proceed to the packaging warehouse and pick up three crates of fresh cucumbers. Transport the crates to the produce loading bay adjacent to the farm market store. Wait for the market staff to arrive and unload the crates. After the unloading is complete, move to the battery charging station behind the greenhouse and remain there for 20 minutes before returning to the maintenance bay.

Proceed to the central storage barn and collect two bales of hay. Transport the hay bales to the feeding area at paddock 3 on the east pasture. Wait for 8 minutes while the caretakers offload the hay. Once complete, drive to the water tank station near the windbreak trees and pick up a sealed canister of water treatment chemicals. Deliver the canister to the pump house beside the irrigation reservoir and wait until the operations manager has unloaded it before returning to the central storage barn.

Drive to the greenhouse annex and pick up three trays of tomato seedlings. Deliver the trays to Plot 7 in the west grove and wait for 10 minutes while the farm staff unload the seedlings. After unloading, proceed to the tool shed by the gravel lane and collect an empty fertilizer spreader. Transport the fertilizer spreader to the composting zone behind the old barn and wait until the equipment manager confirms it has been unloaded, then return to the greenhouse annex.

Head to the equipment storage garage at the east perimeter and pick up two spare tractor tires. Deliver the tires to the maintenance pit beside the grain silos. Wait until the maintenance technician removes both tires from the robot. After delivery is confirmed, navigate to the irrigation control hut near the south fields and wait for 15 minutes for further instructions from the supervisor.

Proceed to the farm workshop located behind the orchard and collect three containers of hydraulic fluid. Transport the containers to the north barn storage bay. Upon arrival, wait for the barn staff to unload all hydraulic fluid containers from the robot. Once unloaded, proceed to the shaded charging station near the west entrance of the property and connect for battery recharge. Remain at the charging station for 20 minutes before resuming further tasks.

Travel to the orchard's north entrance to collect four empty produce crates. Take the crates to the south field picking area and wait for them to be loaded with harvested vegetables. Once loaded, transport the filled crates to the cold storage facility. Remain at the facility for 10 minutes to allow for unloading, then proceed to the refueling station near the equipment shed and await further instructions.

Travel to the south field and pick up three empty water barrels. Transport the barrels to the water refill station near greenhouse C. Wait for the barrels to be filled, then deliver the full barrels to the irrigation supply area. Once delivered, return to the central control hub and await further instructions.

Proceed to the maintenance shed and pick up the box of replacement sprinkler heads. Deliver the box to the equipment staging area beside field 7. Wait for 10 minutes while technicians retrieve the needed parts from the box. Once the box is empty, return it to the maintenance shed and park at the designated charging station.

Navigate to the vineyard equipment shed situated at the southern edge of the property. Pick up four empty pesticide sprayer tanks. Deliver these tanks to the decontamination area beside the greenhouse. Once at the decontamination area, wait until all sprayer tanks are removed from your payload. After unloading, proceed to the nearby tool kiosk and collect two replacement spray nozzles, then return to the vineyard equipment shed to complete the task.

Proceed to the compost storage area behind greenhouse three and collect three sacks of fertilizer. Transport the sacks to the northern vineyard entrance and wait for the field crew to fully unload all fertilizer sacks from the robot. Once the items are unloaded, continue to the weather monitoring station at the west hilltop and stand by for 10 minutes for any urgent sensor maintenance requests.

Head to the spare parts shed adjacent to the solar panel field. Retrieve two replacement drive belts and one toolbox from the storage racks. Transport all retrieved items to the conveyor maintenance bay along the southern fence. Wait until a maintenance technician has collected the toolbox and one drive belt. Next, proceed to the water pump station at the end of Export Lane to collect three empty chemical drums. Deliver the empty drums to the chemical storage zone behind the main processing building, then return to the spare parts shed to await further assignments.

Drive to the fertilizer storage barn and pick up two sealed barrels of organic fertilizer. Transport the barrels to Crop Field West. Wait for the field operator to unload the barrels from the robot, then proceed to the storage area behind the equipment shed and stand by for further tasks.

Proceed to the orchard entrance and collect four empty harvest bins. Take the bins to Orchard Row 7. Wait while the farmhands fill each bin with apples. After all bins are loaded, deliver the full bins to the packing barn and wait until the bins are completely unloaded from the robot.

Travel to the vineyard maintenance tent and pick up two coils of repair wire and a toolbox. Deliver these items to the southern trellis row for the maintenance team. Wait at the southern trellis row until the toolbox is removed from the robot. Then, proceed to the composting site beside the equipment shed and retrieve one empty compost bin. Carry the empty bin to the cafeteria loading dock for cleaning. Wait for 12 minutes to allow cafeteria staff to unload the bin. Once finished, return to the equipment shed and await further tasks.

Proceed to the irrigation control station and collect two replacement water filters. Transport the filters to the south orchard entrance, deliver them to the maintenance team, and wait for 5 minutes before returning to the storage facility.

Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed and collect one pallet of nitrogen fertilizer bags. Navigate to field plot 7 and deliver the pallet next to the irrigation pump station. Wait for the field crew to remove the fertilizer bags from the pallet. Once the pallet is empty, transport it to the recycling area adjacent to the admin building. Wait there for 10 minutes for further instructions.

Drive to the maintenance garage and pick up two sealed toolboxes. Transport the toolboxes to Wind Turbine Station 3 on the northern field. Wait until a technician removes both toolboxes from the robot, then proceed to the supply depot for your next assignment.

Proceed to the workshop garage and collect two sealed containers of lubricating oil. Deliver the containers to the irrigation pump station by the east field. Upon arrival, wait until both containers are unloaded by the maintenance crew. After unloading is complete, return to the workshop garage and stand by for 5 minutes before the next task.

Drive to the equipment shed, pick up a set of pruning shears and three spools of nylon wire, then transport them to vineyard sector 7. Wait for the vineyard crew to retrieve the items, and once unloaded, proceed to the refueling station before returning to the equipment shed.

Travel to the maintenance garage and pick up a toolbox and two spare hydraulic hoses. Proceed to the north orchard service lane and deliver the items to the repair crew. Wait at the location until a technician confirms receipt of all parts, then return to the garage for your next assignment.

Travel to the seed storage hut behind the greenhouse and pick up three sacks of corn seed. Deliver the sacks to the south field staging area. Wait for 10 minutes while the field crew unloads the seed, then proceed to the equipment wash station and wait to be washed before returning to your docking bay.

Travel to the maintenance shed and pick up two spare tires. Deliver the tires to the equipment repair yard and wait until a technician removes them from the robot. After the tires have been unloaded, proceed to the fuel depot and wait for 10 minutes before awaiting your next assignment.

Drive to the greenhouse loading bay and pick up three trays of young tomato seedlings. Navigate to field section B, near the southern irrigation line, and deliver the trays. Wait for the field staff to finish transplanting seedlings and remove the empty trays. Once the trays are empty, collect them and return to the greenhouse loading bay. After arrival, wait for 5 minutes in standby mode for possible new tasks.

Proceed to the spare parts depot near the machine sheds and collect a sealed box of tractor filters. Drive to the repair bay behind Factory 2, deliver the box to the maintenance supervisor at the bay entrance, and wait until the supervisor confirms receipt of all filters. Once unloaded, continue to the greenhouse complex main gate. Pick up two containers of nutrient solution from the delivery cart and transport them to the hydroponic station inside the central greenhouse. Wait for 7 minutes while technicians fill the tanks, then return to the spare parts depot.

Travel to the main greenhouse and collect two containers of organic fertilizer. Transport the fertilizer to Plot C near the irrigation pond. Wait at Plot C until the greenhouse supervisor confirms the containers are unloaded. After receiving confirmation, proceed to the machinery garage for scheduled maintenance.

Navigate to the grain silo on the northwest field edge and collect two 50-kilogram sacks of fertilizer. Deliver the sacks to plot number 3 in the vegetable garden. Wait at the delivery site for 10 minutes to allow field workers to unload the fertilizer. Following completion, proceed to the tool barn and await further loading instructions.

Travel to the vineyard supply shed and collect a crate of replacement grape trellises. Deliver the crate to the southern vineyard plot. Wait until the maintenance team has removed the crate from the robot. Afterwards, proceed to the irrigation control center and remain there for 12 minutes to oversee scheduled system checks, then return to the vineyard supply shed.

Proceed to the vineyard loading area and pick up three crates of harvested grapes. Deliver the crates to the cold storage facility by Warehouse B. Wait at the cold storage facility until all the crates are unloaded, then travel to the equipment shelter to await further instructions from the operations manager.

Proceed to the orchard storage shed and pick up three baskets of harvested pears. Transport the baskets to the central packing station beside the distribution barn. Wait for up to 15 minutes while the packing crew unloads all baskets. Return to the orchard storage shed once the task is complete.

Drive to the greenhouse storage room and pick up four flats of young tomato seedlings. Transport the seedlings to the west garden plots near the compost bins. Wait for 10 minutes while the gardening team unloads all the seedlings. After unloading is complete, proceed to the equipment shed at the north end of the fields and wait for the maintenance supervisor to load a box of replacement sprinkler heads onto the robot. When the box is loaded, deliver it to the irrigation control kiosk by the southern hedgerow. Once the box has been removed, return to the greenhouse storage room.

Drive to the orchard storage barn and collect three empty harvest bins. Transport the bins to the southeast apple grove, wait for 15 minutes while harvesters fill the bins, then deliver the filled bins to the packing station near the north gate. Once unloaded, remain at the packing station until further instructions.

Proceed to the materials depot and pick up four rolls of irrigation tubing. Drive to the east orchard entrance and wait for 5 minutes for the installation crew to arrive. Once the crew signals, deliver the tubing beside the worker's staging tent. Wait until the crew removes all tubing from the robot. After unloading, travel to the north storage compound and collect a set of empty wooden crates. Return the empty crates to the materials depot and await further instructions.

Travel to the maintenance garage and collect two replacement hydraulic hoses. Proceed to the vineyard equipment zone and deliver the hoses to the machinery technician. Wait at the equipment zone for up to 12 minutes in case any used hoses need to be returned. If given used hoses, transport them back to the maintenance garage.

Head to the seed storage barn located next to the north field. Collect three bags of organic fertilizer from the storage barn. Transport these fertilizer bags to Plot 7 on the east side of the property. Wait at Plot 7 until all bags have been completely unloaded by the field crew. When the unloading is finished, proceed to the farm's irrigation control room and stand by for further instructions.

Navigate to the greenhouse loading bay and pick up three containers of organic fertilizer. Deliver these containers to plot section B2 in the vegetable garden. Wait until the containers have been unloaded by the gardening staff. Once unloaded, proceed to the nearby composting area and collect two bags of compost. Return the compost bags to the greenhouse loading bay and wait for the head horticulturist to inspect the delivery before leaving the area.

Proceed to the maintenance depot near the east gate and pick up one replacement hydraulic pump. Navigate to the north vineyard equipment shelter and deliver the hydraulic pump. Wait until a technician unloads the pump from the robot, then move to the main path and await further instructions for 5 minutes before returning to standby at the central garage.

Drive to the seed storage barn located behind the main farmhouse and collect six bags of wheat seeds. Navigate to field plot 12 on the eastern boundary and deliver the seed bags to the planting team. After delivering the seeds, wait for 10 minutes while the team inspects and sorts the bags. Once the waiting period is complete, proceed to the fuel depot adjacent to the storage barn and pick up a fuel canister. Transport the fuel canister to the tractor parking area near field plot 4, and wait until a farm operator removes the canister from you before returning to the seed storage barn.

Travel to the barn storage area beside the south paddock and pick up three sacks of poultry feed. Drive to the free-range chicken enclosure near the windbreak trees and deliver the poultry feed. Wait until all sacks have been unloaded by the animal care team. Once unloading is finished, proceed to the equipment wash bay and stand by for 10 minutes for potential cleaning operations.

Proceed to the parts storage annex and collect a replacement hydraulic hose and two bottles of lubricant. Convey these items to the tractor repair area located behind the north barn. On arrival, wait for the maintenance crew to retrieve the hydraulic hose from the robot. After the item is removed, travel to the orchard's midpoint tool cache and collect any empty spray canisters found there. Deliver the empty canisters to the chemical supply depot beside the weather station. Upon delivery, wait for 10 minutes to allow staff to inspect and record the returns. Afterward, return to the main garage and park near the charging station.

Travel to the chemical storage shed and pick up a sealed canister of pesticide. Transport the canister to the southwest vineyard and wait until a field technician retrieves it from the robot. After delivery, proceed to the irrigation control booth and stand by for 5 minutes to assist with monitoring system operations. Finally, return to the south gate maintenance area.

Proceed to the orchard equipment shed and collect two spare tractor wheels. Drive to field plot 7 and deliver the wheels near the north boundary. Wait for 10 minutes while the maintenance crew installs the wheels onto the tractor. Once the parts have been unloaded from the robot, continue to the administrative office foyer and wait until a staff member loads a box of paperwork onto the robot. Transport this box to the archives room in the main compound and wait for the box to be removed before returning to the charging station behind the packing facility.

Go to the packing shed at the southern orchard and collect a pallet of empty apple cartons. Transport the pallet to the apple picking area at the west grove. Wait for 12 minutes while workers load freshly picked apples into the cartons. Once loading is complete, carry the filled cartons to the produce weighing station beside the barn. After delivering the cartons, proceed to the maintenance garage and stand by for your next assignment.

Proceed to the irrigation control station located near the northern greenhouse, retrieve the sealed toolbox, and deliver it to the maintenance area behind the equipment storage barn. Upon arrival, wait until a technician removes the toolbox from the robot, then return to the charging post by the main entrance road.

Proceed to the storage silo near the eastern field and collect three bags of granular fertilizer. Deliver the fertilizer bags to the compost preparation area adjacent to the greenhouse. Wait for 10 minutes while the horticulture team unloads the bags and prepares their mixture. Once the bags are removed, drive to the equipment charging station, wait there for 8 minutes to allow for auxiliary device maintenance, and finally navigate back to the storage silo to await further instructions.

Travel to the main orchard supply depot and collect two crates of pollination drones and a single canister of maintenance oil. Bring these items to the north orchard control hub. Wait for the technical team to unload both crates and the oil. Once unloaded, proceed to the west fence access gate for a routine perimeter check, wait there for 6 minutes, then return to the main orchard supply depot.

Begin at the central equipment depot and pick up two empty water tanks. Travel to the cattle pasture in the southern section of the farm. Wait until the tanks are filled by the farm workers. Once filling is complete, deliver the now-full water tanks to the shade shelter near the orchard. After unloading the tanks, return to the central equipment depot and await your next assignment.

Begin at the orchard loading zone and pick up three crates filled with freshly harvested apples. Transport the crates to the packing shed on the west side of the property. Upon arrival, wait for the packing crew to unload the crates, which should be completed within 7 minutes. After unloading is complete, proceed to the maintenance shack near the irrigation pond to collect a set of replacement sprinkler heads. Deliver the sprinkler heads to the field supervisor waiting at vineyard plot 3 and stand by until they have taken all parts, then return to the orchard loading zone.

Start at the equipment garage beside the south field fence and collect a box containing drone batteries. Deliver the box to the control station overlooking wheat field 4, and wait until the field technician removes all batteries from the robot. Proceed to the fertilizer storage shed next to the gravel road beyond the cattle pen, pick up two large sacks of organic fertilizer, and deliver them to the garden plots behind the horticulture classroom. Wait for 5 minutes as the gardening crew unloads the sacks. Once unloading is complete, head back to the equipment garage.

Travel to the fertilizer storage shed near the north fence and pick up two sealed fertilizer bags. Deliver the bags to the greenhouse loading area. Wait for 10 minutes while workers distribute some of the fertilizer, then collect any remaining bags. Return the leftover bags to the fertilizer storage shed and remain there, ready for the next task.

Drive to the greenhouse loading zone behind the equipment shed and pick up three trays of young tomato seedlings. Deliver the trays to the seedling propagation tent near the northern irrigation tanks. Wait for the horticultural staff to transfer the seedlings from the robot. After the transfer is complete, move to the compost collection area behind the main barn and stand by for 10 minutes until the compost manager signals the next task.

Go to the main orchard entrance and pick up a bundle of replacement tree stakes. Transport the bundle to the apple grove maintenance area near the irrigation reservoir. Wait until all stakes have been unloaded by the farm staff. Next, proceed to the solar-powered tool charging station behind the barn, collect a crate of freshly charged pruning shears, and deliver them to the vineyard plot A adjacent to the hillside trail. After confirming the crate has been removed, travel to the vehicle bay for standby until further instructions.

Drive to the seed storage barn and pick up five sacks of winter rye seeds. Deliver these sacks to the planting crew at the south end of field parcel C, and wait for 20 minutes while the crew distributes the seeds along the planting rows. Once the robot has been unloaded, proceed directly to the maintenance garage and wait until a mechanic places two toolboxes on the robot. Take these toolboxes to the solar panel array utility station for use in routine maintenance, and remain there until the toolboxes have been removed by the technician before departing.

Start at the maintenance room and retrieve a spare hydraulic hose. Proceed to the east boundary irrigation pump station and wait until the repair crew arrives to install the hose. Once installation is confirmed, transport the removed faulty hose back to the maintenance room, and then remain on standby for 15 minutes for potential urgent deliveries.

Begin at the equipment depot next to the machinery shed and collect three sealed pesticide drums and one empty pallet. Transport the pesticide drums to the citrus grove spray station near the southern fence line. Wait until each drum has been unloaded by the spray crew. After all drums have been removed, proceed to the composting area behind the tool workshop and collect the collected sacks of organic waste awaiting transfer. Deliver the sacks to the bio-processing facility adjacent to the water treatment pond. Upon delivery, wait for 15 minutes for the facility staff to scan and log the incoming materials. Once acknowledged, return to the equipment depot and await further deployment orders.

Begin at the parts storage area and retrieve four sealed chemical canisters. Drive to the greenhouse supply depot and wait for the horticulture supervisor to inspect and sign off on the delivery, for up to 10 minutes. Once approved, unload the chemical canisters at the depot. Then, proceed to the solar charging station near the admin building for a 20-minute recharge before returning to the parts storage area.

Head to the maintenance garage and pick up the spare tire cart. Transport the cart to the machinery repair bay on the east field. Wait until the technician has removed the old tire and placed it onto the cart, then return both the old tire and the cart to the maintenance garage. Once back, remain in standby mode until further notice.

Proceed to the fuel depot located behind the silo and pick up three sealed fuel canisters. Deliver the canisters to the drone charging station at the north end of the vineyard. Wait at the charging station for the on-site operator to unload the canisters. After unloading, drive to the equipment cleaning bay next to the greenhouse and wait for 10 minutes before returning to the main control center.

Proceed to the irrigation equipment shed and collect three coiled hoses. Transport the hoses to the east end of the vineyard, where the irrigation team is stationed. Wait on site for up to 10 minutes as the team unloads all the hoses. After the hoses have been removed, travel to the orchard tool depot to retrieve a large empty crate. Deliver the crate to the central apple-loading dock and remain there until the crate is filled with harvested apples and securely placed back on the robot. Once loaded, return the crate to the orchard tool depot.

Proceed to the spare parts storeroom located behind the central maintenance hangar and collect two crates of replacement hydraulic valves. Transport the crates to the wind turbine service platform on the eastern hilltop. Wait until the maintenance crew unloads both crates from the robot. After unloading, drive to the livestock feed bin near the animal care center and pick up one sack of mineral supplements. Deliver the sack to the nutrition mixing bay inside the feed warehouse. Once the sack is delivered, remain on standby for 10 minutes in the warehouse loading zone before returning to the spare parts storeroom for further instructions.

Travel to the greenhouse supply shed next to the irrigation canal and retrieve four seedling trays. Deliver the trays to Plot B in the southern vegetable field. Wait until the planting crew confirms successful unloading. Next, proceed to the compost collection site behind the barn and pick up two compost bins filled with organic matter. Transport the bins to the orchard mulching area and remain on site for 7 minutes while the orchard workers unload the compost. Afterward, return to the greenhouse supply shed to wait for additional loading.

Travel to the spare parts storage unit located beside the service garage and pick up a box containing assorted mechanical parts. Transport the box to the tractor maintenance bay just south of the grain silos. Wait at the maintenance bay until the repair crew has finished unloading all the mechanical parts from the robot. After the unloading is complete, proceed to the battery charging station near the western entrance of the facility and remain there for 15 minutes before heading back to the spare parts storage unit.

Proceed to the west orchard tool shed and collect one toolbox along with a pair of pruning shears. Transport these items to Vineyard Row 7, next to the compost pile. Wait at the location until the maintenance crew retrieves the tools. Once the toolbox and shears have been unloaded, proceed to the farm garage, and enter standby mode without delay.

Move to the potato storage barn and pick up two sacks of harvested potatoes. Deliver the sacks to the loading platform adjacent to the produce market kiosk. Wait for 8 minutes to allow the market staff to unload the sacks. Once offloaded, drive to the maintenance hut for a scheduled cleaning, and stay there until the cleaning crew has finished and signals you to depart.

Drive to the greenhouse supply room and collect four empty planting trays. Take the trays to the nursery area adjacent to the north field. Wait for the horticulture team to load the trays with young tomato seedlings. After all trays are loaded, transport them to Plot C near the west irrigation ditch and wait 10 minutes for the farm crew to unload the seedlings. Once done, proceed to the equipment shelter and await further assignments.

Navigate to the orchard equipment shed and collect one crate of tree pruning tools. Bring the crate to the east vineyard section, and wait until the field staff unload the equipment. Once unloaded, proceed to the compost transfer zone behind the barn and pick up a sack of animal feed. Deliver the sack to the livestock enclosure and wait for 10 minutes to ensure successful handover before returning to the parking bay for standby.

Travel to the maintenance workshop near the northern orchard entrance and pick up a crate of replacement sprinkler heads. Deliver the crate to the irrigation control point at the center of the vineyard. Wait until the vineyard technician retrieves all sprinkler heads from the robot, then proceed to the compost yard behind the main storage barn. Collect a bundle of empty collection baskets and transport these to the apple harvest zone along field lane 3. Once the baskets are unloaded, return to the maintenance workshop for the next task.

Start at the storage warehouse and collect four sealed bags of fertilizer. Navigate to the tomato field's southern entrance and deliver all fertilizer bags to the supply tent located there. Wait until the field staff finish unloading the bags, which may take up to 8 minutes. After the bags have been removed, proceed to the fuel depot beside the old barn, pick up a single barrel of diesel, and transport it to the generator station near greenhouse 2. Remain at the generator station until the diesel barrel is unloaded, then return to the storage warehouse.

Proceed to the orchard storage hut and pick up three empty produce crates. Transport the crates to the fruit collection station near Field A. Once delivered, wait up to 10 minutes for the workers to load filled fruit crates onto the robot. After receiving the full crates, move them to the cold storage warehouse and unload them at the receiving bay. Finally, return to the orchard storage hut and await further instruction.

Drive to the orchard equipment shed next to the eastern row of apple trees and pick up two empty pesticide containers. Transport the containers to the chemical refilling station by the north perimeter fence. Wait for the station attendant to refill both containers and load them back onto the robot. Once the containers are secured, deliver them to the field supervisor post just beyond the irrigation canal. Wait at the supervisor post for 10 minutes before returning to the orchard equipment shed.

Travel to the seed storage room beside the maintenance garage and pick up two bags of sunflower seeds. Deliver the bags to Field Plot 7 near the south irrigation canal. Wait at Field Plot 7 until the planting team has unloaded both bags. After unloading, proceed to the equipment charging station near the tool depot and remain there on standby until further instructions.

Begin by traveling to the eastern storage shed and retrieve two jugs of organic pesticide. Transport these to the northern field entry point, where the crop-dusting crew will be waiting. Once at the field, wait until both jugs have been unloaded by the crew supervisor. After the transfer, head to the maintenance alleyway next to the machinery garage and collect a box of spare wheel bearings. Finally, deliver the wheel bearings to the harvest equipment lot at the south perimeter fence, and then await further tasks for 10 minutes at the lot.

Proceed to the fertilizer storage barn situated west of the main greenhouse and pick up three nutrient solution drums. Transport the drums to the orchard’s central mixing station. Wait until the station operator has unloaded all drums from your platform. Once the transfer is complete, return to the main operations shed and await further tasks.

Head to the maintenance garage and pick up two sealed battery packs. Deliver the battery packs to the wind turbine relay station at the edge of the northern pasture. Wait for a technician to remove the used battery packs and load the new ones onto the control platform. Once the technician signals that the exchange is complete, return to the maintenance garage for further tasks.

Begin at the storage barn and collect three sacks of fertilizer. Transport the sacks to the northeast corner of the apple orchard. Wait until a farm worker removes all sacks from the robot. Next, proceed to the irrigation control station and pick up a sealed container of water samples. Deliver the container to the field lab located beside the main greenhouse. Wait at the field lab for 7 minutes to allow the lab technician to collect the sample. After completion, return to the storage barn and stand by for the next assignment.

Proceed to the equipment depot beside the eastern irrigation canal and pick up the toolbox marked 'Field Repairs.' Travel to wind turbine station 2 on the southern ridge and deliver the toolbox to the maintenance crew stationed there. Wait at the station until the crew removes the toolbox and places a used hydraulic pump on the robot. Once the hydraulic pump is secured, transport it back to the repair workshop in the central service building and deliver it at the intake counter.

Proceed to the maintenance workshop adjacent to the south gate and pick up a single crate of spare machinery parts. Transport the crate to the tractor storage barn near the east paddock. Wait until the maintenance supervisor has completely unloaded all parts from the robot, then travel to the tool depot beside the irrigation control shed and await further instructions.

Start by traveling to the pallet storage zone adjacent to the southeast warehouse and collect four wooden pallets. Next, navigate to the staging area at the entrance to the apple orchard. Deliver the pallets and wait until the harvest team removes all pallets from the robot. Once the pallets are unloaded, proceed to the solar panel maintenance shed west of the main farm office. Retrieve any used cleaning cloths you find and return them to the central laundry facility behind the cafeteria. Do not wait after the drop-off—immediately proceed to the compost station near the south fence and stand by there for 8 minutes before returning to the maintenance garage for parking.

Head to the irrigation equipment hut near the eastern orchards and pick up the set of replacement sprinklers. Deliver the sprinklers to the grapevine maintenance area beside the stone wall. Wait for 20 minutes while the vineyard staff installs the equipment and removes the empty packaging onto the robot. Return the empty packaging to the recycling zone behind the machinery garage. Once the payload is unloaded, proceed to the shade structure adjacent to the citrus grove and wait for 5 minutes before continuing any further tasks.

Start at the tools workshop and pick up the set of replacement tractor blades. Navigate to the eastern field entrance and deliver the blades to the field technician waiting near the equipment shelter. Stand by for up to 15 minutes while the technician installs one of the blades, then wait for the technician to place two broken blades onto the robot. Afterward, transport the damaged blades to the recycling container area beside the compost facility and wait until the blades are unloaded before finishing the task.

Travel to the equipment charging bay located north of the workshop and pick up two solar battery units. Deliver the battery units to the eastern vineyard maintenance outpost. Wait while the maintenance crew unloads both batteries from your platform. When unloading is finished, proceed to the grape sorting area and wait for 7 minutes before returning to the equipment charging bay.

Go to the battery charging station next to the central barn and wait until a technician attaches two spare lithium-ion battery packs onto the robot. After loading, drive to the remote weather monitoring tower at the southern field edge and deliver the battery packs. Remain at the site for 10 minutes to allow the monitoring team to replace the old batteries and place a container of climate sensor samples onto the robot. Once loaded, return to the central barn and deliver the climate sensor samples to the data processing room inside the barn.

Proceed to the eastern storage barn and pick up five sacks of seed potatoes. Transport the sacks to the north field planting site. Upon arrival, wait for 20 minutes while workers unload the sacks. Once unloading is complete, return to the equipment yard and stand by for the next assignment.
